Manish vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:7627) on 6 February,
2025
Author: Kuldeep Mathur

Bench: Kuldeep Mathur [2025:RJ-JD:7627]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 1505/2025 Manish S/o Shri Gopal Lal, Aged About 20 Years, R/o Cheta Chareda Ka Badiya , Kamligarh , Ps - Deogarh , Dist Rajsamand (Presently Lodged At Dist Jail Rajsamand)

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Love Jain For Respondent(s) : Mr. Lalit Kishore Sen, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 06/02/2025 1.

This application for bail under Section 483 of BNSS (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.205/2024 registered at Police Station Deogarh, District Rajsamand, for offences under Sections 363 & 376(2)(n) of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the victim 'N' was having friendship with the present petitioner since long and she called the present petitioner and eloped with him.
A missing person's report came to be lodged on 02.06.2024 by the father of the victim.

The victim was discovered on 06.06.2024 and upon being examined under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., she clearly stated that she had voluntarily eloped with the present petitioner on 01.06.2024 and accompanied him to Ahmedabad.
The victim in [2025:RJ-JD:7627] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-1505/2025] her statements further stated that the petitioner did not commit forcible sexual assault upon her.

3. Lastly, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner, who is aged about 20 years is in judicial custody since 20.10.2024; the investigation against the petitioner has already Manish vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:7627) on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81903270/
1 been concluded and the trial against him will take sufficiently long time, therefore, no purpose would be served by keeping the petitioner behind the bars for indefinite period and thus, the petitioner deserve to be enlarged on bail.
4.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

However, he was not in a position to refute the fact that the victim 'N' was examined under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
and she had admitted that she voluntarily eloped with the present petitioner and travelled with him to Ahmedabad out of her own free will and volition.
5. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

6. Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this Court prima facie finds that the victim 'N' has eloped with present petitioner out of her own free will and volition.

This Court also prima facie finds that the victim 'N', in her statements recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., has not levelled allegation of she being subjected to forcible sexual assault against the present petitioner.

The prosecution has not shown any apprehension of the petitioner influencing the victim 'N' or other material prosecution witnesses of the case or feeling away from justice, in case he is enlarged on bail.

Thus, without [2025:RJ-JD:7627] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-1505/2025]
expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

7. Accordingly, the bail application under Section 483 of BNSS is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner- Manish S/o Shri Gopal Lal shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.205/2024 registered at Police Station Deogarh, District Rajsamand, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to so.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 114-Dinesh/-
